Applicants need a BBA or Management graduation, 03 years of relevant experience and must be below 35 years of age. The pay is Rs.40,000/- a month (consolidated CTC). Applications are accepted online until 11:59 PM on 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About BECIL
content_sections.text: Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited is a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting and a Mini Ratna Company. Its head office is at I.P. Estate, New Delhi, and its corporate office is at Sector-62, Noida. In this recruitment, BECIL engages manpower for its client, DMIL.

content_sections.heading: BECIL Executive/HR Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The place of posting is New Delhi, NCR or any city in India. The number of vacancies is tentative and depends on the requirements of the Client/Principal Employer. BECIL also reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised vacancies. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: BECIL Executive/HR Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Below 35 years. Nationality: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Qualification: BBA/Management Graduate from recognized University. Experience: 03 years in field of HR/Office administration/Diverse functions, MIS Reports preparation. Computer skills: Working knowledge on computers is essential. Metro working knowledge: The candidate should be abreast with the working of Metro Rail/HR/Associated works. A Master's (MBA) degree. Past work with DMRC or a Metro Rail Company, either directly or through its contractors. Local candidates and/or candidates with relevant experience in the same or similar department may also be given preference, subject to the Client's requirements. Candidates previously engaged by BECIL and/or the Client are not eligible if their services were terminated, discontinued or not renewed because of disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance or violation of contractual terms. The official notification gives the complete eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online as part of the application. Once paid, it is non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances. BECIL states that it does not demand or accept any other payment from candidates at any stage of the recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized and shortlisted on the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post. BECIL may adopt suitable shortlisting criteria, including higher qualifications or greater relevant experience. Preference may also go to candidates with superior academic credentials or other desirable criteria set by the Client/Principal Employer. The list of shortlisted candidates is forwarded to the Client/Principal Employer. The Client carries out the further selection process, which may include an interview, assessment, skill test or any other evaluation method it decides. Shortlisted candidates are told the date, time and venue or mode through registered email and/or telephone. Selected candidates are informed of their selection and later formalities through email and/or telephone. Meeting the eligibility conditions does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for any stage. BECIL is not obliged to publish interim results, stage-wise shortlists or marks. Candidature stays provisional at all stages and is subject to verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: Purely contractual. Contract period: The notice prints two different periods. Its opening paragraph says the engagement is for one year, while the post table says "3 years on contract basis, extendable as per performance." Police verification: The selected candidate must submit a valid Police Verification Report at Document Verification after selection. Failure to do so makes the selection liable to cancellation. False information: If a discrepancy is found after engagement, services may be terminated forthwith and legal action may also be initiated.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Executive/HR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the BECIL application portal to complete the online registration process. Fill in your personal details under new registration and register. Proceed to the other details and the payment to complete your application. Upload or provide all requisite documents specified for the post's eligibility criteria. After the online payment is successful, save the application receipt. faq.question: Q1. Is an MBA compulsory for the BECIL Executive/HR post?
faq.answer: No. The mandatory qualification is BBA/Management Graduate, and an MBA only earns preference.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need Metro Rail work experience to apply?
faq.answer: Past work with DMRC or a Metro Rail Company is a preference, not a stated requirement. The mandatory 03 years of experience can be in HR, office administration, diverse functions or MIS Reports preparation.

faq.question: Q3. Which organisation will I actually work for?
faq.answer: BECIL engages the candidate on contract and deploys them in the office of Delhi Metro International Limited (DMIL), which is the client in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. Can I contact DMIL directly about my application?
faq.answer: No. Candidates must not communicate with or approach the Client/Principal Employer about this recruitment, and canvassing in any form leads to disqualification.

faq.question: Q5. Can I correct my application after submitting it?
faq.answer: No. Requests to modify, correct or alter any submitted information are not entertained, so check every entry before the final submission.

faq.question: Q6. Will BECIL pay travel costs for the interview or joining?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is admissible for attending any test, document verification, interview, personal interaction or skill test, or for joining duties after selection.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the final result be published?
faq.answer: Only the final list of candidates selected by the Client/Principal Employer is published on the BECIL website.

faq.question: Q8. Who do I contact for help with this advertisement?
faq.answer: The helpdesk numbers are 0120-4177850 and 0120-4177860, and the email address is [email protected].
